Just a heads-up for everyone ordering chicken from Blinkit.

Today I ordered a 450 g pack of Godrej boneless chicken. I usually don’t check the weight, but this time I was making a recipe that required exactly 450 g, so I placed it on my kitchen weighing scale.

To my surprise, the pack weighed only 380 g, not 450 g.

I contacted Blinkit, and they promptly refunded me for the shortfall, which I appreciate. However, that’s not really the point. Most customers don’t weigh their groceries every time they receive an order, so discrepancies like this can easily go unnoticed.

My suggestion to everyone is to check the weight of chicken, fish, or any other items sold by weight whenever possible. Hopefully, this was just an isolated packing error, but it’s worth being aware of.

I ordered 3 Amul Red Tetra Pack milk cartons, but instead received 6 Amul Moti milk pouches. These are different products with different packaging, and the quantity delivered did not match my order. The product I ordered was also more expensive than what I received.

If the ordered product was unavailable, the correct approach would have been to inform me, seek my approval for a substitute, or issue a refund. Instead, the product was changed without my knowledge or consent.

I immediately contacted support, attaching screenshots of my order showing the Amul Red Tetra Pack and photographs of the Amul Moti milk pouches that were actually delivered. Despite this clear evidence, I received a generic response claiming that the seller had "thoroughly reviewed" the order and confirmed that the delivered product matched the order and app description, so no refund or exchange would be provided.

I then pointed out the obvious facts:

Amul Red Tetra Pack and Amul Moti milk pouches are completely different products.
The delivered quantity did not match my order.
I asked how they concluded that the order was fulfilled correctly despite the evidence.
Instead of answering these questions, they simply claimed they had tried calling me twice. I never received any missed call or answered call on my registered number. I even asked them to provide the date, time, and phone number from which they supposedly called, but they ignored that request as well.
I also requested the evidence used during their so-called verification, such as packing verification records or CCTV footage from the packing station, if available. Again, no response—just the same copied-and-pasted template stating that the seller had verified everything and no refund or exchange would be processed.

Since Zepto provides virtually no effective customer support and directs customers to email, I contacted the delivery partner myself. I have an audio recording in which he stated that the seller had intentionally substituted the product and that if the customer complained, they would normally accept a return or process a refund.

I later spoke directly with the seller, and I have that conversation recorded as well. The seller admitted that the originally scanned tetra packs were damaged and were replaced with six milk pouches before dispatch. Even more importantly, the seller confirmed that no one from Zepto had contacted them regarding my complaint before my claim was rejected.

This directly contradicts Zepto's repeated claim that the seller had thoroughly reviewed the order. Either no proper investigation was conducted, or the responses sent to me were simply generic templates without verifying the facts.

I informed Zepto of this new information and even shared the recordings, requesting a proper re-investigation. Their response? The exact same copied message yet again:

"The seller has thoroughly reviewed your order and confirmed that the product was delivered in good condition as per the app description. Unfortunately, the seller is unable to process a refund or exchange."
I even emailed their main support address with the entire conversation, hoping it might reach a real support team rather than an automated system. I received no response, even after waiting until the next day. The in-app chat simply kept directing me to email support, and there appears to be no customer care phone number available for customers to escalate genuine issues.

I am a regular buyer of Amul Red Tetra milk, and my order history clearly reflects that. I have never ordered Amul Moti milk pouches. It makes no sense for a customer to purchase a more expensive product and then falsely claim they received a cheaper substitute.

The most disappointing part wasn't the delivery mistake—it was Zepto's refusal to investigate despite screenshots, photographs, audio recordings, and even the seller's own admission. Every response was a copy-paste template that ignored the actual facts.

Based on my experience, I cannot recommend ordering from Zepto. If something goes wrong with your order, don't expect a meaningful investigation or accessible customer support.
